args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Fixed in fastjson 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to address **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

The advisory lists 2.9.4 and 3.1.0 as fixed versions; I chose 2.9.4 to stay on the 2.x major line and avoid a major-version migration.

## CI
CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878 passed.

## Review
Requesting review from @alex.
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
